List down the materials details of 200X2X12 countply, BPC substrate and G000704 Fibretype

SELECT m.material_code, m.shade_name, m.finish_type, m.fastness_type
FROM t_material AS m
JOIN t_thread AS t ON m.thread_id_fk = t.thread_id
WHERE t.count_ply = '200X2X12'
  AND t.substrate_code = 'BPC'
  AND t.fibre_type = 'G000704';

What threads have a substrate code of 'BPC'?
SELECT thread_id, count_ply, fibre_type FROM t_thread WHERE substrate_code = 'BPC'
